name: Lictor Brood
equipped_with: Every model is equipped with: Flesh hooks, Scything talons, Piercing claws.
abilities: Deep Strike, Hit & Run, Infiltrate, Move Through Cover, Stealth, Squadron, Terrifying(-1), Use Cover
Assassin: If all attacks are resolved against a single model, the model may re-roll all to hit rolls.
Chameleonic Skin: The model does not scatter when being set up via Deep Strike. Additionally, it gains Charge benefits normally and doesn't have to make a Disorderly Charge.
Neurolictor: Select one enemy unit within 12" during your activation. The target must pass a Leadership test or gain one Battleshock token.
